matters: Matter 2019-014 (closed 2020-06): Hollis & Reyes LLP represented Brightline Properties LLC, defending it against tenant Dovetail Bakery in a commercial lease dispute. Responsible partner: Elena Hollis.
Matter 2021-007 (closed 2022-03): Hollis & Reyes LLP represented Marlow Health Partners in an employment arbitration; adverse party: former COO Gregory Penn. Responsible partner: Marcus Reyes.
Matter 2022-031 (closed 2023-01): Hollis & Reyes LLP represented Quarry Lane Builders in a construction lien claim against Westbrook Holdings. Responsible partner: Elena Hollis.
Matter 2023-012 (open): Hollis & Reyes LLP represents Northgate Logistics as plaintiff against Carver Freight Inc. in a breach-of-contract action. Responsible partner: Marcus Reyes.
Matter 2024-005 (closed 2024-11): Hollis & Reyes LLP represented Ines Okafor in the sale of her dental practice to Brightway Dental Group. Responsible partner: Priya Natarajan.
Witness: in Matter 2021-007 the firm deposed Lena Brandt, CFO of Marlow Health Partners.
